exact: regulation of RNA elongation from RNA polymerase II promoter
regulation of transcription elongation from RNA polymerase II promoter
related: regulation of gene-specific transcription elongation from RNA polymerase II promoter

definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of transcription elongation, the extension of an RNA molecule after transcription initiation and promoter clearance by the addition of ribonucleotides, catalyzed by RNA polymerase II.
label: regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II
